note: Role classification cases for the production classifyPaper(). `roles` is the exact set of active role keys (ROLE_KEYS order), which is what the panel filters and the row accents are driven by.

cases.note: sole first: two authors, no marker anywhere
cases.authors: Ningfeng Que, Hao Tang

cases.note: sole first of three
cases.authors: Ningfeng Que, Mingzhe Li, Hao Tang

cases.note: co-first via a shared * with the second author (owner first)
cases.authors: NingFeng Que*, Xiaofei Wang*, Jingjing Chen, Yixuan Jiang, Chao Li

cases.note: co-first via a shared * where the owner is second
cases.authors: Deliang Li*, Ningfeng Que*, Hao Tang, Yanwen Tian

cases.note: co-first via a shared † (dagger)
cases.authors: Mingzhe Li†, Ningfeng Que†, Juanhua Zhang, Pingfan Du

cases.note: co-first via shared Unicode superscripts
cases.authors: Ningfeng Que¹, Xiaofei Wang¹, Chao Li²

cases.note: co-first via a shared affiliation digit
cases.authors: Ningfeng Que1, Xiaofei Wang1, Chao Li2

cases.note: different affiliation digits are not equal contribution
cases.authors: Ningfeng Que1, Xiaofei Wang2

cases.note: a marker nobody shares leaves the owner as sole first
cases.authors: Ningfeng Que*, Xiaofei Wang

cases.note: an unshared marker on the second author is not co-first (but the owner is still the second and last author)
cases.authors: Xiaofei Wang, Ningfeng Que*

cases.note: plain second author
cases.authors: Yujia Sun, Ningfeng Que, Peiting Shi

cases.note: second author who is also corresponding (✉)
cases.authors: Peiting Shi, Ningfeng Que✉, Xianzhen Huang, Xiaofei Wang

cases.note: last author of a byline with no ✉ at all is treated as corresponding
cases.authors: Xiao-Fei Wang, Hanyu Liu, Yiran Zhao, Yuan Gao, Ningfeng Que

cases.note: last author, but somebody else carries the ✉, so not corresponding
cases.authors: Xiao-Fei Wang✉, Hanyu Liu, Ningfeng Que

cases.note: middle author of a long byline
cases.authors: Zhiqiong Wang, Hanyu Liu, Ningfeng Que, Boyang Zhao, Junchang Xin

cases.note: truncated byline ('et al.') can never make the owner the last author
cases.authors: Xiao-Fei Wang, Hanyu Liu, Ningfeng Que, et al.

cases.note: single author paper
cases.authors: Ningfeng Que

cases.note: shared ✉ between the first two authors is co-first + corresponding
cases.authors: Ningfeng Que✉, Xiaofei Wang✉, Chao Li

cases.note: a ✉ shared only between later authors is not co-first
cases.authors: Chao Li, Yin Dai, Ningfeng Que✉, Wei Liu✉

cases.note: regression: two surnames ending in the same letter must not look like a shared marker
cases.authors: Ningfeng Que, Jian Xie

cases.note: co-first and last author at the same time (two author paper, both marked)
cases.authors: Deliang Li*, Ningfeng Que*

cases.note: a paper the owner is not on has no role at all
cases.authors: Yujia Sun, Peiting Shi, Yin Dai
